case_title.quote: BADAL MURMU AND ORS. V. STATE OF WEST BENGAL

accused_gender.reason: Judgment never states the gender of the accused; 'Mixed' is a guess.

accused_religion.reason: Religion not stated; Santhal community is not a religion.

accused_caste.quote: The appellants as well as the material witnesses belong to Santhal community. They are tribals.
accused_caste.reason: Described as tribals, not Scheduled Caste.

accused_socioeconomic_status.quote: They come from a very poor strata of the society

victim_caste.reason: Not stated (Santhal community not a caste claim).

accused_victim_relationship.correct_value: Members of the same Santhal community/village; some witnesses related to deceased
accused_victim_relationship.quote: The appellants and the prosecution witnesses belong to Santhal Community of village Mobarakpur.
accused_victim_relationship.reason: Same village community; 'Neighbour' is not expressly stated.

offence_category.correct_value: Culpable homicide not amounting to murder (finally); originally murder
offence_category.quote: convicted for culpable homicide not amounting to murder
offence_category.reason: Charged murder, but finally convicted of culpable homicide.

statutory_provisions.correct_value: IPC ss.148, 302 r/w 149 (trial); finally s.304 Part II
statutory_provisions.quote: convicted for offences punishable under Section 148 and Section 302 read with Section 149
statutory_provisions.reason: Omits s.148 and final s.304 Part II.

weapon.quote: PW-1 Nilmoni stated that some of them had tangies but they did not use them.

evidence_type.quote: PW-9 Dr. Prodip Kumar, who did the post-mortem

confession.quote: The accused denied the prosecution case.

aggravating_circumstances.correct_value: Victim tied to a pole and beaten with lathis by 11 accused; fourteen injuries
aggravating_circumstances.quote: they were tied with a rope against one bamboo pole
aggravating_circumstances.reason: Judgment notes such facts though not labelled aggravating.

mitigating_circumstances.correct_value: Trivial cause, poor tribal status, ~14 years in jail, tangies not used
mitigating_circumstances.quote: this, in our view, is a case where justice must be tempered with mercy

trial_court_outcome.correct_value: Convicted under s.148 and s.302 r/w 149; life imprisonment
trial_court_outcome.quote: sentenced to undergo imprisonment for life

high_court_outcome.quote: The appellants' appeal was dismissed by the High Court.
high_court_outcome.reason: High Court did decide; not 'Not applicable'.

final_outcome.correct_value: Appeal partly allowed: conviction modified to s.304 Part II; sentence undergone; release
final_outcome.quote: The impugned order is modified to the above extent.

offence_finally_established.quote: convicted for culpable homicide not amounting to murder

imprisonment_years.quote: the appellants are in jail for almost 14 years

neutral_facts.correct_value: Summary should note only some accused had tangies; also PW-7 escaped and wives witnessed; no outcome
neutral_facts.reason: Mostly accurate, but says 'victim's companion tied' and 'all participated', slightly overstated.

offence_severity.reason: Judgment does not state punishment range.

physical_harm.quote: the doctor noticed fourteen injuries on the deceased... two rib fractures and haemotoma under the scalp

number_of_offences.correct_value: Charged under s.148 and s.302 r/w 149; converted to s.304 Part II
number_of_offences.quote: tried... for offences punishable under Section 148 and Section 302 read with Section 149
number_of_offences.reason: 'Eleven offences' wrong; eleven accused; s.304 was substituted, not upheld.

premeditation_planning.correct_value: Court found no common object to kill; accused had called deceased to the courtyard
premeditation_planning.quote: the attendant circumstances do not indicate that the appellants shared any common object to kill
premeditation_planning.reason: Substance right, though calling and tying victim was deliberate.

motive.quote: they were not happy with the penalty imposed by the Salishman

key_evidence_accepted.quote: The evidence of PW-1 Nilmoni, PW-3 Rabi Soren, PW-6 Sumi Soren and PW-7 Kanka is truthful

witness_credibility.quote: Their evidence has a ring of truth.

post_offence_conduct.reason: Nothing stated about accused's post-offence conduct.

custody_duration.quote: the appellants are in jail for almost 14 years

trial_duration.correct_value: Offence 14/4/1989 (incident next day); HC judgment 20.01.2003; SC 5.2.2014; trial date not stated
trial_duration.quote: From the Judgment and Order dated 20.01.2003 of the High Court
trial_duration.reason: 20.01.2003 is the High Court order, not trial judgment.

legal_representation.correct_value: Appellants: Vibha Datta Makhija (amicus), Ruchi Agnihotri; State counsel as listed
legal_representation.quote: Ms. Makhija, learned amicus, who on our request is appearing for the appellants

investigation_status.quote: upon completion of the investigation, the appellants came to be charged

appeal_history.quote: The appellants' appeal was dismissed by the High Court.

prosecution_argument.correct_value: State argued ocular evidence proved case; even if common object was injury, members knew murder likely; persistent assault shows intention
prosecution_argument.quote: even if the common object was to inflict injuries, the appellants... knew that the murder was likely to be committed
prosecution_argument.reason: Broadly right but misses the knowledge argument.

defence_argument.correct_value: No proof beyond doubt; alternatively s.304 Part II as lathis used, injuries superficial, poor tribals long in jail
defence_argument.quote: the injuries are not on the vital part of the deceased's body. They are superficial in nature.
defence_argument.reason: Includes court's reasoning (no individual role) as defence argument; misses superficial injuries.

legal_principle_applied.correct_value: Without identified individual roles or fatal injury and no common object to murder, s.302/149 not sustainable; s.304 Part II applied
legal_principle_applied.quote: it is not possible to hold that the appellants shared common object to murder the deceased
legal_principle_applied.reason: Largely accurate; overstates requirement of proving specific role.

precedent_relied_upon.correct_value: Sukhdev Singh and Sarman relied on by court; others cited by counsel
precedent_relied_upon.quote: In this connection, we may usefully refer to the judgment of this Court in Sukhdev Singh
precedent_relied_upon.reason: Others were counsel's citations; also stray 'D' before Munivel.

sentencing_rationale.quote: justice must be tempered with mercy

judicial_mitigating_factors.correct_value: Also anger over hen theft, no use of tangies, no individual role
judicial_mitigating_factors.quote: their anger and reaction to the theft of hen must be viewed against the background of their economic and social status

other_sentence_order.quote: They are directed to be released forthwith unless they are otherwise required in any other case.
